title: Optimal Sparsifiers for Abelian Cayley Graphs
summary: We prove that for every Cayley graph $\mathcal{G}$ over any finite abelian group $G$, there is a weighted Cayley graph with $O(\log |G|)$ generators that is a spectral sparsifier for $\mathcal{G}$. This bound is optimal. Applying our bound to the group $G = \mathbb{F}_2^n$, yields, as a corollary, $O(n/\varepsilon^2)$-sized code sparsifiers for $\mathbb{F}_2$-linear codes, improving on the work of Khanna, Putterman and Sudan (SODA'24) who obtained a similar result with an additional $\mathrm{polylog}(n)$ loss.
